PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  May 06, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900 -6833,
meeting ID: 857 7751 3040 and Password 359138 on May 06, 2024, at 9:00 am.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Cpt. Reginald Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez/, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L.Thompson, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Juan Rodriguez DBA RJ’s Demolition & Disposal to host a Customer Appreciation
  Day Event at 1135 E. Frence Ave.,- Private Property, on Wednesday, May 08, 2024,
  from 7:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO
  THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event within private parking
  lot; parking signage for guest must depict where to park ; Applicant must hire four
  (4) Licensed security guards; All Security Guards shall wear reflective vests; A
  Watch Commander will be notified; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA
  State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384493)
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
